categories.name: About
categories.description: The principles the whole Outcast mod family is built against.

categories.name: Outcast Hearing
categories.description: Gunfire damages your hearing, ear protection reduces it, and quiet time brings it back.

categories.name: Outcast Husbandry
categories.description: Your animals get hungry and thirsty far more slowly, so a few days away does not come back to a dead herd.

categories.name: Outcast Ladders
categories.description: Climb the ladders that are already in the world.

categories.name: Outcast Lib
categories.description: Shared runtime for the Outcast mod family. This mod adds no gameplay of its own.

categories.name: Outcast Light Load
categories.description: Hauling raw materials stops being the whole afternoon.

categories.name: Outcast Motors
categories.description: The engine bay has run on a dedicated server; the fluids have not, and finding out is what this build is for.

categories.name: Outcast Motors Animated
categories.description: Animated car panels for the vanilla vehicles: bonnets, doors, windows, boots and tailgates that open, with an engine bay behind the bonnet.

categories.name: Outcast Motors UI
categories.description: A vehicle mechanics window that shows you the whole car at once, on the car.

categories.name: Outcast Proximity
categories.description: Every container you can already reach, as one list.

categories.name: Outcast Punch
categories.description: Punch zombies with your bare hands. The vanilla shove is untouched.

categories.name: Outcast Rip All
categories.description: One context-menu button that rips every rippable garment in your inventory and the containers around you.

categories.name: Outcast Saw All
categories.description: One context-menu button that saws every log you can get to, in your bags and on the ground around you.

categories.name: Outcast Stow All
categories.description: One button files your mixed loot into the containers around you that already hold that item.

categories.name: Outcast Upright
categories.description: Right an overturned car, truck or trailer with a jack and some sweat.
